# Poll every feed on a fixed five-minute interval

## Context and Problem Statement

The collector has to decide how often to re-fetch each subscribed feed. A single
cadence is easy to reason about and easy to rate-limit.

## Decision Outcome

Every feed is polled every five minutes, regardless of how often it publishes.
Feeds that fail three times in a row are skipped for one hour.

## Consequences

Quiet feeds are fetched far more often than they change, which wastes both our
bandwidth and the publisher's. See [[000002]] for the replacement.
